title: Gigli distributional sectional-curvature characterization
exact_target: For a complete separable metric space (X,d), integer $n\geq 2$ and $\kappa \in R$, is being an n-dimensional Alexandrov space of curvature $\geq \kappa $ equivalent to full-support $RCD((n-1)\kappa ,n)$ with measure $H^{n}_d$ and distributional curvature satisfying $R(A,B,B,A)(f)\geq \kappa \int f(|A|^{2}|B|^{2}-\langle A,B\rangle ^{2})dH^{n}$ for every nonnegative test function f and test vector fields A,B? Use the unreduced RCD and test classes in the cited theorem.

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.

manuscripts.title: Gigli's distributional curvature characterization of Alexandrov spaces
